name: Lau tom 5 ri
summary: Lẩu tôm 5 ri is a hotpot of small shrimp. Vietnam Airlines simmers the broth from bones and seafood, sours it lightly with tamarind or pineapple, and prints 180,000–280,000 VND.
origin: Vung Tau. Vietnam Airlines prints 166 Trương Công Định and no separate shop name.
texture: Vietnam Airlines calls the shrimp firm and naturally sweet.
howToEat: Eat from the pot with greens, mushrooms, and bún or mì.
The hour is Check on arrival.
where: 166 Trương Công Định. The hour is Check on arrival.
